shape.doc: A shape is drawn at its own place on the 1920 x 1080 canvas, whatever slot it sits in (the slot decides only when it is on screen), so a picture can be built from many shapes, each timed on a word and each checked by QA. All numbers are canvas px and can be tweened (`<Tween on="bar" h={300}>` grows a bar, `<Tween on="arrow" draw={1}>` draws a line). Look: `fill`, `stroke`, `strokeWidth`, `radius` (a rect's corner); a `text` is drawn centred in a rect or circle with the `size`, `color`, `weight` and `font` of the look.

fields.name: x
fields.doc: rect, circle, icon and svg (an ellipse inscribed in the box; an icon or a drawing fitted into it): the box

fields.name: x1

fields.name: arrow

fields.name: path

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: icon: a name from the built-in set (`visotalk schema icons`), drawn in `look.stroke` with `look.strokeWidth` on a 24-unit grid (default 2); `look.fill` fills it

fields.name: svg
fields.doc: svg: a drawing as SVG markup (`<svg viewBox="…">` with path, circle, ellipse, rect, line, polyline, polygon and g only; their own colours kept) fitted into the box

fields.name: draw
fields.doc: How much of the outline is drawn, 0 to 1 (default 1)

fields.name: pacing
fields.doc: Narration pacing used by the time solver (seconds); defaults in parentheses

fields.name: components
fields.doc: L2 registrations

fields.name: params
fields.doc: Interactive parameters; exports use defaults

fields.name: objects
fields.doc: Identity registry: every visual object that appears anywhere

fields.name: flow
fields.doc: Branching graph; absent = linear order of scenes/beats

fields.name: overrides
fields.doc: L1

fields.name: lang
fields.doc: BCP-47 primary language of `lines`

fields.name: lines
fields.doc: Narration; absent = silent beat, then `duration` is required

fields.name: hold
fields.doc: Extra hold after the last line

fields.name: pattern
fields.doc: Per-beat pattern change (e.g. full → split): a full pattern, or a patch merged over the current one. Objects keep identity across the change.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Object state at the start of this beat (partial props). Objects present in consecutive beats interpolate by identity; objects absent from `state` keep their previous state. An object (or sub-part) whose first entrance-or-exit action in the scene is an entrance (other than countUp) is hidden from the scene start until that entrance, unless a state in the scene shows it earlier; `visible: false` is only needed for other cases.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: Caption text

fields.name: say
fields.doc: Pronunciation; derived from `text` by the normaliser when absent. May carry marks that name words for anchors: `{#name}…{/name}` a range, `{@name}` a point. They are stripped before the text is spoken, aligned or compared.

fields.name: live
fields.doc: Player-only caption with live values, e.g. "z = {fmt(x * y, '0.0')}". Spoken audio is fixed, so narration must not state param-dependent values; put them here instead. Exports use `text`.

fields.name: words
fields.type: Array<{w: string; t0: Seconds; t1: Seconds; /** how sure the aligner was, 0 to 1; absent for a word without letters */ p?: number}>
fields.doc: Word timings in seconds from the line start (filled by forced alignment; estimated when absent)

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Unique in the document; another action's `at.after` names it

fields.name: during
fields.doc: With a range mark in `at` and an entrance motion: the target is on screen for the range, and leaves at its end

fields.name: stagger
fields.doc: Delay between multiple targets

fields.name: params
fields.doc: Motion-specific: e.g. kenBurns {from:[scale,x,y], to:[...]}, flow {direction:'backward'}, set {props} and tween {props: {name: number}} (the numeric props reach those values over `dur`, from the value they have then; on a component, its props) (on a field path, `{value}` replaces the field's value from then on), morph {to:[x,y]} (moves a graph node, and the edges on it, to that position across the graph's region, 0 to 1)

Anchor.doc: Anchors resolve to absolute time via the time solver. `word` is either a phrase that must occur in the line's `say` (first occurrence) or a word index; `mark` names a mark written into the line's `say` instead, and is exclusive with `word`. `edge: 'end'` on a range mark is its last word's end.
Anchor.definition: | {line: Id; word?: string | number; mark?: string; edge?: 'start' | 'end'; offset?: Seconds} /** Inside a beat, `ref` may be omitted (the enclosing beat); in overrides it is required */ | {beat: 'start' | 'end'; ref?: BeatRef; offset?: Seconds}

fields.name: slots
fields.doc: Named slots of the pattern → object ids

PatternPatch.doc: Beat-level pattern change without `kind`: merged over the beat's current pattern (the scene pattern or the previous beat's result). `slots` entries replace slots by name and `null` removes one; `options` merge key by key.

board.doc: General-purpose board: kicker, title, a band under the title (chips, legend), main area with an optional side column (`options.side`: width ratio, default 0.3 when a `side` slot is used), and a note line at the bottom. `options.band: false` gives the band's height to main.

stage.doc: A picture as large as the frame allows: a compact title (kicker and a 90 px title) and one big `main` below it, ending above the captions; `note` is an optional line at the bottom that takes its height from main. Without a title slot, main rises to the top of the area.

title.doc: Title card: the title region fits the display styles (up to 240 px type); everything ends above the captions

timeline.doc: A track of dated items across the top (`track`), with a detail area underneath: `left` (photo), `right` (text) and `note` under the right column. `main` is the whole area below the title for a timeline on its own.

photoStory.doc: Documentary layout over full-bleed media. `options.split` (0..1) gives that share of the width, on the right, to a `side` region (second photo); `sideLabel` sits in its corner. Text regions run down the left: lowerThird, statement (a row of overlay chips), upper (taller row, e.g. stat cards), center (large centred text), lower, foot.

split.doc: Two columns; `options.ratio` is the left share, `options.below` reserves a full-width row of that height underneath
